scope: PrefillState / DecodeState resource facts, preparation consumption, batch ownership, exact generation fences, preemption protocol ownership and queue wakeups
review_result: No remaining blocking finding in the reviewed scope; latest full UT and repeated complete performance matrix passed.
fixes: Keep Prefill work captures and projection versions when full Worker observations change only activity timestamps. Activity facts still reach Scheduler; changed phases, unknown occupancy, terminal members and repacked predictions invalidate the capture.
Reject observations belonging to another Worker generation before Prefill status reduction and Decode initialization can mutate resources or retire the valid Endpoint.
design_contract_clarifications: Ordinary Decode completion must allow a newer authoritative ACTIVE observation and a new reservation token. Universal completion tombstones were tested, contradicted existing contracts, and reverted. WorkerStatus fences older status versions; special cancellation/local-release/absence history retains its existing scope.

Callback-free exact resource CAS may remain inside the Context monitor to linearize resource settlement and request protocol. Capacity notifications, RPC, prediction and workflow effects execute outside the corresponding ownership locks.
verified_boundaries: Prepared Prefill capabilities are consumed on commit; committed records do not retain reservation lifecycle.
Committed batches own member sets; no whole-request-table batch membership reconstruction remains.
PreemptionCancelPhase has one protocol owner in PreemptionRegistration; DecodeState retains resource claims and cancellation handoff facts only.
Decode resource records, victim claims and settled history have separate ownership; engineLifecycleOwned is removed.
WorkerBatcher uses the shared queue lock for selection revalidation, commit, control-inbox checks and Condition waits; capacity listeners subscribe before availability checks.
States do not invoke Scheduler, RequestRepository retention callbacks, prediction or capacity listeners. Endpoint executes returned facts/effects.
Exact route / reservation token / generation checks prevent old callbacks from affecting replacements.

first_unprofiled_matrix.failure: BATCH 10000 client throughput 9651.7 < 9800; all other cases passed.

isolated_batch_with_gc_logging.gc_note: Includes startup/warmup/measurement; does not establish the cause of the first matrix failure.

performance.limitation: The same source produced one failed BATCH throughput result and two passing repeats. No threshold was relaxed; run-to-run variability remains and its cause is not proven.
